newsitem.title: TURKEY: Nine dead, 25 missing from sunken boat off Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Nine dead, 25 missing from sunken boat off Turkey.

text.p: Nine Iraqi illegal immigrants have died and 25 others are missing after a small boat carrying them from Turkey to Greece capsized in the Aegean Sea, a coastguard official said on Thursday.
"There is not much hope for the others," the official told Reuters. "They have been in the water for 15 to 16 hours," he said.
He said six people had been rescued from the boat, which capsized and sunk 15 minutes after leaving a lonely spot on the Turkish shore near the resort town of Cesme on Wednesday night.
Iraqis, mainly Kurds, often flee economic hardship and armed conflict in north Iraq for Europe via Turkey. Flimsy boats carry them on the short trip to Greece.
The official said a police helicopter and coastguard boats were searching for any survivors.
The alarm was raised by a fisherman who saw corpses in the water on Thursday morning.
